title: $32 Billion Empire Gone in 9 Days #shorts
description:
In November twenty twenty-two, FTX was one of the biggest crypto exchanges on Earth. Nine days later it was bankrupt, and eight billion dollars of customer money was missing.
Follow for more stories of money that vanished overnight.
hook_text:
A $32 BILLION EMPIRE
GONE IN 9 DAYS
first_comment: Who's more to blame: the founder, or the investors who handed him billions without checking? 👇

lines.text: In twenty twenty-two, a crypto exchange worth thirty-two billion dollars died in just nine days.
And the money inside was already gone.
FTX was run by a thirty-year-old in shorts, praised as a genius and a billionaire.
Then a leaked balance sheet showed his trading firm was built on a token he invented himself.
Customers panicked. Six billion dollars in withdrawals hit in seventy-two hours.
Customer deposits had been secretly sent to his trading firm, and spent.
A rival offered to buy the company. One day later, it walked away.
On November eleventh, FTX filed for bankruptcy.
About eight billion dollars of customer money was missing.
Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted of fraud and sentenced to twenty-five years in prison.
Follow for more stories of money that vanished overnight.
